latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Step-by-step guided skill for making durable coiled pine needle baskets using both agent and human labor.
- Agent handles pine species identification, needle quality checks, coil math, harvest/coil/dry scheduling, pattern templates, and inventory/barter logging.
- Human performs all physical tasks: harvesting, sorting, coiling, shaping, and manual testing.
- Includes automated protocols for troubleshooting, progress tracking, and trade-value recommendations.
- Provides ready-to-use templates and scripts for harvest logs, coiling progress, and barter offers.
- Clear division of labor, safety reminders, and gradual mastery path make sustainable basket production accessible and repeatable.
